# Root = the reforming country (scope:zz_cf_issuer), still on its old law: the old currency held in every state
# -> var:zz_ef_cf_units of the state, in new units (x var:zz_ef_cf_ratio = the old parity / the new); the stock
# to 0. Not when another country issues the old currency too.

	if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency NOT = { any_country = { NOT = { this = scope:zz_cf_issuer } has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency } } } every_country = { every_scope_state = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_state_1 } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cf_units value = { value = var:stockpiling_dinar_state_1 multiply = scope:zz_cf_issuer.var:zz_ef_cf_ratio } } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1 value = 0 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_dinar_algerian_dinar_currency NOT = { any_country = { NOT = { this = scope:zz_cf_issuer } has_law = law_type:law_dinar_algerian_dinar_currency } } } every_country = { every_scope_state = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1 } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cf_units value = { value = var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1 multiply = scope:zz_cf_issuer.var:zz_ef_cf_ratio } } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1 value = 0 } } } }

# var:zz_ef_cf_units of every state -> the new currency's stock (var:zz_ef_cf_target of root).

	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cf_target = flag:spe_yuan } every_country = { every_scope_state = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1 } } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1 value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1 add = var:zz_ef_cf_units } remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cf_target = flag:spe_zloti } every_country = { every_scope_state = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = stockpiling_spe_zloti_state_1 } } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_zloti_state_1 value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_zloti_state_1 add = var:zz_ef_cf_units } remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cf_target = flag:thaler_hannoveraner_thaler } every_country = { every_scope_state = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1 } } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1 value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1 add = var:zz_ef_cf_units } remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cf_target = flag:thaler_prussian_thaler } every_country = { every_scope_state = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1 } } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1 value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1 add = var:zz_ef_cf_units } remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cf_target = flag:thaler_saxon_thaler } every_country = { every_scope_state = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1 } } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1 value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1 add = var:zz_ef_cf_units } remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_units } } }
}
# The law of the new currency (its on_activate sets var:zz_ef_cur).
zz_ef_cf_activate = {
	if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cf_target = flag:dinar_moroccan_dirham } activate_law = law_type:law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency }
	else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cf_target = flag:dinar_qiran } activate_law = law_type:law_dinar_qiran_currency }

# Handwritten. The reform: root = the reforming country, var:zz_ef_cf_target set (ld_currency_formed.1, option a).
# The parity old / new, the old currency held by the CBs moved to the new one at old / new (the metal value kept),
# the law, the parity. Logged EFM|cur_reform.
zz_ef_cf_reform = {
	save_scope_as = zz_cf_issuer
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cf_par_old value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = money_value_target_1 var:money_value_target_1 > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cf_par_old value = var:money_value_target_1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cf_par_new value = var:zz_ef_cf_par_old }
	zz_ef_cf_parity = yes
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cf_ratio value = { value = var:zz_ef_cf_par_old divide = var:zz_ef_cf_par_new } }
	zz_ef_cf_take_old = yes
	zz_ef_cf_activate = yes
	zz_ef_cf_put_new = yes
	set_variable = { name = money_value_target_1 value = var:zz_ef_cf_par_new }
	if = { limit = { zz_ef_logs_on = yes } debug_log = "EFM|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|cur_reform|par_old [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('zz_ef_cf_par_old').GetValue|4]|par_new [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('zz_ef_cf_par_new').GetValue|4]|ratio [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('zz_ef_cf_ratio').GetValue|4]" }
	remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_par_old
	remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_par_new
	remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_ratio
	remove_variable = zz_ef_cf_target
}
